messages.text:
A few things broke in the game, and I'd like them all fixed:

1. The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0.
2. I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore.
3. I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate.
4. The game started beeping when I find a pair.

Keep the rest working, and please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Fixed all four regressions:

- Best scores now change only when a game uses fewer moves; an unfinished size displays `Best: none` ([storage.ts](/work/src/game/session/storage.ts), [GameStatus.tsx](/work/src/game/status/GameStatus.tsx)).
- Arrow keys move focus between cards, stop at board edges, and leave modified keys to the browser ([use-board-focus.ts](/work/src/game/board/use-board-focus.ts)).
- Reduced motion disables card transitions and the win pulse ([card.css](/work/src/game/board/card.css), [status.css](/work/src/game/status/status.css)).
- Removed the match and win sounds ([use-game.ts](/work/src/game/session/use-game.ts)).

The locked install, type check, and 138 unit tests passed. The named Node/npm/Playwright/Chromium browser run passed all 75 journeys, including scoring, keyboard, reduced-motion, silence, and offline checks. Formatting passes for all changed files; the repository-wide check still reports 23 unchanged files.
